title: Ultrafast Immunolabeling and 3D Imaging of Whole Organs and Large Tissues
author: Ding, Liu, et al.

steps.title: Convert raw image data
steps.instruction: Use the Imaris File Converter (Bitplane) to convert the acquired raw image files into Imaris‑compatible format.

steps.title: Analyze data with Imaris
steps.instruction: Open the converted files in Imaris software (version 9.9.0, Bitplane) and perform the following analyses:

substeps.instruction: Reconstruct and process Z‑sections of the light‑sheet images; define Regions of Interest (ROI) for each channel and generate surface renderings.

Set resolution for vessels or spots; use the Surface Analysis XTensions to quantify vascular density; apply the 3D crop tool to measure total tissue volume; smooth the ROI, subtract background, and preview final images.
Create animations and perform quantitative analyses using advanced Imaris tools for comprehensive visualization.
Conduct quantitative analysis based on surface rendering and ROI definitions; note that basic processing can be done with ImageJ, but advanced surface, spot rendering, and animation require Imaris.
